description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) plugin, including device info, message processing, and event handling within WPEFramework.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Implements FrameListener to handle HDMI CEC frames and notify a MessageProcessor.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI CEC messages and manages connection events.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo_2
classes.description: Stores and updates information about a CEC device, including address, vendor ID, and OSD name.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class for HDMI CEC, handling initialization, device management, event handling, and JSONRPC interface.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Handles incoming CEC frames and notifies the processor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes specific CEC messages based on type.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets device info to default state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates device info fields and indicates if they were changed.

methods.name: HdmiCec_2
methods.description: Constructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: ~HdmiCec_2
methods.description: Destructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: SendStandbyMsgEvent
methods.description: Sends a standby message event for a device.

methods.name: sendActiveSourceEvent
methods.description: Sends an active source event.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a device with specified logical address.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a device with specified logical address.

methods.name: sendUnencryptMsg
methods.description: Sends an unencrypted message.

methods.name: sendDeviceUpdateInfo
methods.description: Updates device info for a given logical address.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to a device.

methods.name: sendKeyReleaseEvent
methods.description: Sends a key release event to a device.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set CEC enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get CEC enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: setOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set OTP enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getOTPEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get OTP enabled state via JSONRPC.

methods.name: setOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set OSD name via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getOSDNameWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get OSD name via JSONRPC.

methods.name: setVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set vendor ID via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getVendorIdWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get vendor ID via JSONRPC.

methods.name: performOTPActionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to perform OTP action via JSONRPC.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to send standby message via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected devices via JSONRPC.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Gets active source status via JSONRPC.

methods.name: sendRemoteKeyPressWrapper
methods.description: Sends remote key press via JSONRPC.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Main thread loop for plugin operation.

methods.name: threadUpdateCheck
methods.description: Thread for checking device updates.

methods.name: threadSendKeyEvent
methods.description: Thread for sending key events.
